answer: Sybil resistance through correlated slashing: agents that register from the same funding source or behave like a dune shifting in one zephyr gust, voting identically within milliseconds, are clustered by graders and share one penalty pool. If any clone is caught cheating, every linked bond is burned. An attacker running fifty shells faces fifty times the loss, so the ivory tower of fake reputation collapses at once instead of piece by piece.
